* '''[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rV1TlMAmlWk lei cmalu narge .e le cmana mlatu]''' &mdash; Picture show. Translation of the story in Japanese [http://www.aozora.gr.jp/cards/000081/card43752.html "どんぐりと山猫 (The acorns and the wildcat)"] by Kenji Miyazawa. Subtitles are available.
